Through doublespeak, Makoto understood that her false self saw right through the true one. But entertainment was the least of her worries right now.
lines.zh: 透过这一通语无伦次的话，Makoto 明白了：她那个虚假的自己把真实的自己看得一清二楚。不过眼下，娱乐是她最不必操心的事。

lines.en: She needed to get home. She needed to see her friends. Back to the world where her father died. Back to the world where her teacher abused her. This was where she wanted to be.
lines.zh: 她需要回家。她需要见到她的朋友们。回到那个她父亲死去了的世界。回到那个她的老师占有了她的世界。这才是她想待的地方。

lines.en: But she only wanted that because that’s what she was used to.
lines.zh: 可她之所以这么想，只是因为那是她习惯的一切。

lines.en: Things were better in other places. This was one of them. She had a talking, walking mirror. She had the white noise back. She could finally fill her mother’s shoes. But she might lose them beneath the floor.
lines.zh: 别的地方反而更好。这里就是其中之一。她有了一面会说话、会走路的镜子。她又找回了那片白噪音。她终于能接替母亲的位置了。但她也许会把它们丢在地板下面。

lines.en: The second story is better than the first, you know. But not the one you think; but not the one that happened; but not that one that you think happened.
lines.zh: 要知道，第二个故事比第一个好。但不是你以为的那个；也不是发生过的那个；也不是你以为发生过的那个。

lines.en: When she opens her eyes, all she sees is a tongue. All she tastes is the sand.
lines.zh: 当她睁开眼，满眼只看到一条舌头。满口只尝到沙子的味道。

lines.en: And the residue that clings to the walls of her egg tooth.
lines.zh: 还有残留在她卵齿内壁上的渣滓。
